Specification: This module specifies the abstract termination detection problem in a synchronous ring network. It models a set of nodes (numbered 0 to N-1) that can be active or inactive, and a global flag indicating whether termination has been detected. The system allows nodes to terminate, wake up other nodes, and detect termination when all nodes are inactive. The specification includes temporal properties such as liveness (eventual detection of termination), quiescence (once terminated, always terminated), and correctness (termination detection implies actual termination). The model is parameterized by the constant N (number of nodes), which must be a positive natural number.
